art_direction.cta_prominence: CTA zone (OS typesets — do NOT draw text): reserve high-contrast actionable area for 'Detayları Keşfet' — button/pill air only, no rasterized CTA.

art_direction.contrast_strategy: Warm interior palette with navy/ivory type — high contrast for headline and CTA, not price panels
art_direction.negative_space_usage: Conscious breath around headline, feature callouts, and CTA — premium composition, not meaningless empty canvas or random decorative gaps.
art_direction.image_text_balance: Locked living-room interior carries atmosphere; type zones get composed air — roughly 60% visual / 40% message space, flexible not fixed panels.

art_direction.decoration_rule: Decoration only if it serves campaign: no random building sketch, map pin, long gold line, or watermark unless it strengthens sales or brand story.

Deliver a publishable, flattened social advertisement — typography, price hierarchy, CTA, and brand lockups integrated in the composition (not a blank background for later overlay).

LANGUAGE LOCK:
- Campaign language is tr. All user-visible slogans, headlines, CTAs, and supporting lines MUST be tr.
- Do not invent or render English slogans/headlines/CTAs when language is tr.

CAMPAIGN INTENT:
- location
- Primary focus: Adams Morgan'ın canlı atmosferi ve The Temple'ın prestijli duruşu
- Emotional angle: Şehrin kalbinde, canlı bir yaşam

- Objective: The Temple projesinin lokasyon avantajlarını vurgulamak
- Big Idea: Adams Morgan'ın Kalbinde Yaşam
- Hero: Adams Morgan'ın Kalbinde, The Temple'da Yaşa
- Sales Hook: Adams Morgan'ın kalbinde yaşama fırsatı
- Offer:

- CTA: Detayları Keşfet

DESIGN DIRECTION (creative freedom — no fixed panels):
- Visual mood: Adams Morgan'ın canlılığını ve merkezi konumunu yansıtan bir dış mekan görüntüsü
- Hierarchy: Location name / advantage leads; supporting place cues secondary; CTA clear.
- Typography character: Modern ve şık yazı tipleri, dikkat çekici başlıklar

- Image treatment: Preserve real project architecture/photography — enhance atmosphere, do not redesign. Subtle grade toward premium RE editorial.
- Contrast: High readability for primary message and CTA against the locked photograph
- Brand presence: One verified project logo lockup — never invent or duplicate
- CTA importance: Single clear CTA; visible and actionable, not tiny footer text
- Information density: sparse
- Premium level: elevated
